newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT-Lojas Arapua stays a buy.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT-Lojas Arapua stays a buy.

text.p: -- Local bank Geral do Comercio said it is maintaining its buy recommendation on Brazilian retailer Lojas Arapua, which started trading on Sao Paulo bourse late last year.
-- The bank said Lojas Arapua's first-half results confirm a strong expansion in sales.

-- "Compared with Globex Utilidades, its biggest bolsa-listed competitor, the firm shows multiples and some productivity indicators that are more attractive," bank analyst Esther Hiranobe said in a research report.
-- The firm's shares are undervalued compared with others in the sector, "with price-earnings for 1996 projected at 8.6x versus 15.1x for Globex," she said.
-- The bank projects Lojas Arapua will post a 1996 net profit at 47.7 million reais versus 33 million reais last year.
-- Lojas Arapua's preferred was off 10 centavos at 13.40 reais just minutes before the close of trade on the Sao Paulo bourse.
